summary: AWS/GCP account path normalization failure prevents ephemeral sandbox provisioning
description: Issue summary: Ephemeral sandbox creation for ML CI jobs fails with AccessDenied/permission errors during the cloud account role binding phase. Impact: ML CI pipelines cannot spin up ephemeral sandboxes in prod-us-east for several engineering teams, blocking PR validation for model onboarding and some dedicated onboarding tests. Observed failure window started 2026-03-12 09:20 UTC and is reproducible.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Trigger the standard ephemeral sandbox job (ci/ml/ephemeral-provision) for project 'experiment-llm-qa' on prod-us-east.
2) Provisioner invokes IAM sync and creates role binding: provisioner -> createRoleBinding(accountPath, envTag).
3) Auth-broker exchanges ephemeral GCP SA token for AWS STS assume-role with audience set to generated role ARN.
4) STS call fails with AccessDenied and GCP returns iam.serviceAccounts.get denied error.
Expected: ephemeral sandbox succeeds and CI job proceeds to run tests.
Observed: provisioning fails at IAM binding step with deterministic errors in logs (see 'logs').
logs:
[2026-03-12T09:20:41Z] provisioner: INFO starting sandbox provisioning for experiment-llm-qa
[2026-03-12T09:20:43Z] iam-sync: DEBUG computed account_path_normalized='project-experimentllmqa' from original 'experiment-llm-qa'
[2026-03-12T09:20:44Z] auth-broker: WARN STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity failed: AccessDenied: The requested role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-sandbox-project-experimentllmqa-prod is invalid
[2026-03-12T09:20:44Z] gcp-iam: ERROR iam.serviceAccounts.get: permission denied for serviceAccount:ci-provisioner@experiment-llm-qa.iam.gserviceaccount.com
[2026-03-12T09:20:45Z] provisioner: ERROR sandbox provisioning aborted (exit code 42)
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: role name mismatch due to normalization.
Findings: provisioning-service contains a normalization routine that removes hyphens and non-alphanumeric characters and lowercases project IDs. GCP project IDs (and some internal tags) include hyphens and are canonical identifiers; the downstream auth-broker expects the canonical project_id including hyphens when constructing the audience/role ARN. A race was also observed: IAM sync can sometimes operate on a trimmed account_path before the canonical mapping table (cloud-account-mapper) has been updated, producing a transient mismatch.
Reproduce locally by running the normalizer unit and comparing with canonical project_id lookup: normalizer('experiment-llm-qa') -> 'experimentllmqa' while canonical lookup returns 'experiment-llm-qa' and role creation pipeline uses canonical. This divergent input flows to the STS audience string and to GCP SA access checks.
Root cause: two-fold - (1) normalization function aggressively strips hyphens causing ARN mismatch, and (2) cloud-account-mapper writes are not reliably atomic during rapid ephemeral sandbox churn which allows the auth-broker to pick up the normalized path instead of canonical id.

Marco Reyes (assignee) - 2026-03-12: Investigating. Reproduced failure locally by running provisioner with --dry-run. Observed normalization mismatch. Opening temporary debug flag on provisioner to skip normalization for a test run.

SRE Oncall (J. Liu) - 2026-03-12: Confirmed elevated error rate in prod-us-east; redirecting traffic for ephemeral provisioning to staging mapper to reduce failures as a temporary mitigation. See slack thread #infra-access for context: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C12345/p1616161616

Infra Eng (K. O'Connor) - 2026-03-13: Created PR with minimal change to preserve hyphens and to add a feature-flagged atomic write for cloud-account-mapper (https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/742). Will run CI and request canary deploy to prod-us-east after smoke tests.

Marco Reyes - 2026-03-13: Applied workaround: manual mapping entries created for affected projects; re-ran failing CI jobs for teams A and B and observed success. Planning follow-up to roll out fix and add a regression test in auth-broker for audience matching.
resolution: In progress - workaround applied and PR open for fix
resolution_notes:
Workaround: added manual mapping entries for 6 impacted projects and temporarily pointed provisioner to staging mapper (reduces failure rate).
Fix plan: merge PR #742 to provisioner that (a) disables hyphen stripping, (b) adds a canonical-project-id check before generating STS audience, and (c) introduces an atomic write/lock on cloud-account-mapper writes. Auth-broker PR #158 adds a sanity check that audience/role ARNs match canonical_role_map before attempting STS. Post-merge rollout: canary to prod-us-east (1% traffic) -> monitor 1 hour -> 10% -> full.
Follow-ups: add unit/integration tests covering hyphenated project IDs, add monitoring alert when IAM createRoleBinding failures exceed threshold, and document best-practice for naming conventions for ephemeral projects.
Estimated completion: merge and canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-14 03:00 UTC (subject to CI pass).
